gms.name: John
gms.short_bio: An improv-forward GM who blends humor, gritty realism, and collaborative worldbuilding. John is especially strong with young players and newer groups, and brings an inclusive, judgment-free energy to the table.

gms.name: Mike
gms.short_bio: A highly adaptable GM with decades of experience, Mike tailors each game to the group while leaning hard into immersion, rule-of-cool play, and wild settings like Planescape and the Feywild where anything can happen.

gms.name: Jess
gms.short_bio: A collaborative storyteller who builds adventures around the party’s characters, choices, and priorities. Jess runs immersive, character-driven games where backstories matter and every player helps shape the story.

gms.name: Adam
gms.short_bio: Adam builds collaborative stories with real consequences, balancing darker grit with the occasional gonzo spark. His table rewards creativity, flexibility, and shared storytelling.

gms.name: Michelle
gms.short_bio: Michelle creates immersive, roleplay-heavy games shaped by history, atmosphere, and emotional tension. Her table centers consent, communication, and comfort while delivering rich, memorable experiences.

gms.name: Jason
gms.short_bio: Jason builds vivid worlds that encourage players to interact with the environment and each other in meaningful ways. His games prioritize shared storytelling and a welcoming table culture.

gms.name: Lucas
gms.short_bio: A theatrical, roleplay-first GM who makes each table feel like a shared stage. Lucas blends memorable characters, strong imagery, and player-focused storytelling into immersive adventures.

gms.name: Justin
gms.short_bio: Justin runs cinematic, narrative-driven games that flex to the group’s mood and interests. He is patient, versatile, and especially good at helping players realize big character ideas.

gms.name: James
gms.short_bio: James runs atmospheric, collaborative games built around mystery, character discovery, and unsettling stories. His tables welcome new players while making room for humor, shared worldbuilding, and horror that grows stranger as the story unfolds.
